Definition: from G5142; stock (as raised on a farm):--cattle.
BiblicalUsage: thrémma is the word the Bible uses when it means cattle, livestock. In John 4:12, his children, and his cattle.
TheologicalSignificance: A patriarch's children and cattle drinking from the same old well remind me that God's provision has carried families for generations.
